description: MIDI note mappings for Rock Band drums (General MIDI drum kit standard)
modeDescription: Realistic drum kit layout - maps pad positions to actual drum kit ergonomics. See DRUM_MAPPING.md for alternatives.

yellow.name: Low Tom / Small Crash
yellow.realPosition: Drummer's right-up (small tom or right crash)

green.name: Crash Cymbal 1 / Ride
green.realPosition: Drummer's right-low (floor tom or ride cymbal)

cymbal.name: Crash Cymbal 1 / Ride
cymbal.note: Alias for green pad (same MIDI note)

velocity.description: MIDI velocity values (10-127). Rock Band drums send fixed velocity (1-16), mapped to velocity range.

game-based.description: Original Rock Band game mapping (not realistic for drumming)
game-based.reason: Matches Rock Band game color-to-sound assignments

realistic.description: Real drum kit layout (recommended for actual drumming)
realistic.reason: Matches real drum kit ergonomics and positions

reference.gmDrumKit: Uses General MIDI Drum Kit standard (channel 10, notes 35-81)
reference.hardwareDiscovery: Harmonix Drum Kit PS3 (0x12ba:0x0210) - HID byte[0] mapping
reference.documentation: See DRUM_MAPPING.md for detailed explanation of both modes
